source: TSTD, comprehensive mung bean cultivation manual, "សណ្តែកបាយ" [Mung bean], 2013
text: Harvest guidance covers picking/cutting at the point when most pods have turned from green to brown/black (mung bean pods mature unevenly on the same plant, so the manual discusses either a single harvest timed to majority pod maturity, accepting some yield loss from both under- and over-mature pods, or multiple harvest passes for higher-value production). Drying to a safe storage moisture content and clean storage practice (pest-proof containers, cool dry conditions) are covered to protect seed quality and prevent storage pest damage before sale or replanting.
